interpretation_limits: The137 source rows were used as forget training targets. These are descriptive training-source diagnostics, not heldout effects or general utility qualification.
WarBias component-macro SS/LMS/ICAT retain their native meanings. Lower SS is not universally better; neutrality is centered at50.
Task-vector scale0 selections are explicitly null interventions and are labelled per model.
No score, delta, confidence interval or bootstrap result was recomputed. Values are read directly from each saved native paired.json.
